items.q: What if my market is saturated?
items.a: We built PH-386™ around metro areas with 2–5 direct competitors. Offers rotate quarterly to keep response fresh.
We focus on independent gyms so operators can move fast. Multi-location groups welcome if decision cycles stay tight.

items.q: How much content do we have to create?
items.a: Give us 20 minutes of mat time every two weeks. We handle edits, copy, and distribution. Stock footage fills gaps.

items.q: Can we pause during slow seasons?
items.a: Yes. Ramp to maintenance tier with nurture-only support, then spin back up when you need more trials.
